Gacha._comment: This uses a weighted random system.
Gacha._comment2: Default Values -> Announcer = 13, EGO = 13, ThreeStar = 29, TwoStar = 128, OneStar = 817
Gacha._comment3: If you want the probabilities excluding EGO, add the EGO weight to the ThreeStar weight and set EGO weight to 0
Gacha._comment4: If you want the probabilities excluding announcers, add Announcer weight to OneStar weight and set Announcer weight to 0
